findings.review_scope: Registered-source content review of arXiv:2304.06993v2 by Filippo Ascolani and Giacomo Zanella. The PDF has 80 pages, with a margin stamp of 30 October 2023 and title-page date of 31 October 2023. Main text and references end on physical page 27. Only the Appendix A heading at the top of page 28 was inspected; no appendix body was read. Fresh text evidence covers all 27 main-paper pages; the theorem statements, source definitions, supporting conventions and boundary pages were inspected visually.
findings.inventory: Exactly four actual Theorem headings occur: 2.4 on page 7, 3.1 on page 9, 4.2 on page 12 and 6.1 on page 22. The restated Bernstein-von Mises theorem remains included. The regular-font Theorem 4.2 reference in the page-18 figure caption is excluded, as are Lemmas, Propositions, Corollaries and appendix results.
original_statements: Theorem 2.4 preserves the sole A1 hypothesis, each fixed t and M, the two warm-start suprema, exact Gibbs-kernel powers, total variation errors and convergence under Q^(n). It is not converted into uniform-time, pointwise-start or spectral-gap convergence.

Theorem 3.1 preserves the model reference, injective likelihood map, square-root density regularity, nonsingular continuous information, local prior absolute continuity and positive continuous density, compact neighborhood and both testing limits. The correct iid law and infinite-product probability mode remain explicit. The Gaussian mean is I^{-1}Delta, and both the scaled parameter and score sum are defined in full.

Theorem 4.2 preserves model (13), exact sampler (15), worst-case M-warm mixing, B1-B6, both tolerance/initialization quantifiers, the finite bound depending on psi*, epsilon and M, and its high-probability and O_P(1) conclusions. Appendix-only assumptions are not silently omitted.

Theorem 6.1 preserves the inherited setting, the specified initial law (35), printed joint dimension lJ+D, tolerance quantifier, bound depending on psi*, epsilon and c, and the source literal liminf-plus-arrow syntax. It does not impose a new deterministic warm-start constant or replace the specified-start mixing time by a supremum.
source_passages: All 19 source entries and nine auxiliary passages were checked. The data-dependent common-space target sequence, random data law, exact deterministic coordinate scan, warm-start domination class and A1 match pages 4-6. The source injective/measurable transformation condition remains distinct from the next-page bijective wording.

Model (11), finite and infinite iid product measures, the randomized-test convention and the f-model information hypothesis match pages 9-10. The information hypothesis is a theorem excerpt, not a newly invented information formula.

Model (13), exponential-family local prior (14), the stated minimality convention, arbitrary dominated likelihood and exact two-block kernel (15) match pages 10-11. Specified-start mixing and the worst-case warm-start supremum are retained separately, with the generic naming context evidenced on page 5.

The one-group marginal density (16), its score information and separate B1-B3 assumptions match page 12, including the lowercase test subscript and the printed reference-measure notation. The main-text paragraph deferring B4-B6 to Appendix B is preserved as a reference description, not substituted for their missing statements.

The marginal maximum-likelihood initializer and the entire feasible-start measure (35) match page 22: fixed c, uniform shrinking closed hyperparameter ball and product of exact local posterior draws. Conditional factorization on page 2, the practical MLE qualification and the first-block overwrite remark remain supporting context.
findings.dependency_review: All 20 direct uses, all 19 reach sets and all 31 related connections were checked. The generic target sequence, coordinate kernel and A1 reach only Theorem 2.4. Warm-start domination reaches 2.4 and 4.2; specified initialization in 6.1 does not import the earlier warm-start supremum. The f-model and its information reach only 3.1. Randomized tests reach 3.1 and both hierarchical theorems. The hierarchical model/prior, two-block kernel, specified-start mixing, marginal density/information and B1-B3 reach 4.2 and 6.1; worst-case mixing reaches only 4.2. The MLE and feasible start reach only 6.1. Proof-only sufficient-statistic reduction, conditional CLT and spectral-gap bounds are not added as dependencies.
findings.names_and_highlights: Every source entry retains source-derived natural-language keywords and original headings. All selectors identify its own statement/label or a related same-paper theorem occurrence. Source passages, conditions, named assumptions and the theorem excerpt remain distinct. Same notation for the two Fisher-information objects does not cause a cross-model merge.
findings.unresolved_scope: B4, B5 and B6 remain explicitly unresolved_outside_main_text, each linked to Theorems 4.2 and 6.1 with page-12 evidence. The main-text-only census is reviewed and validated, but it does not claim to supply the exact appendix-only conditions. No appendix statements or proofs were read or reconstructed.
findings.source_limitations: All 20 existing notes were reviewed. They preserve the excluded B4-B6 references; injectivity versus bijectivity; conditional-distribution and inverse measurability; data-dependent probability/supremum conventions; coordinate index n versus K; fixed-time scope; unspecified total-variation normalization; t>=0 versus t>=1; warm domination versus TV closeness; full Bernstein-von Mises hypotheses and random mean; printed notation/spelling; prior minimality and arbitrary likelihood; B2 indexing and integration measure; information expectation law; duplicate limit syntax; MLE selection/computation limitations; ball containment in constrained domains; l versus ell; exact scan order versus approximate updates; and the pinned preprint identity. Source fidelity does not certify the results or extend their stated scope.
findings.changes: No census-content correction was required. All six saved JSON artifacts and the original audit remain unchanged. Earlier scripts are archived; the saved rebuild resolves the verified fixed local PDF and no longer requires old temporary source paths or pre-existing text evidence in its output directory.
findings.validation: Independent inventory and census validators pass, and all six regenerated artifacts match saved bytes. Source identity, font-aware theorem enumeration, exclusion of the figure-caption reference, main-text endpoint, all direct/local edge sets, reach sets and paths, selector occurrences, artifact hashes and explicit retention of all three unresolved appendix references supplement the completed manual source review.
